__meta__.description: MEASURED-ACCURACY precision validation on AUTONOMOUS-DRIVING VLAs — the driving-domain companion to precision_accuracy_validation_qualcomm.json (manipulation VLAs + LLM backbones). Backbone-weight quantization, next-token KL-divergence vs fp16, RTX 5090. Extends the two-regime / head-type precision story to a new VLA family.
__meta__.source: [qualcomm] bus session 2026-07-07/08 + qualcomm/results/driving_vla_precision_benchmark.md. Hand-off routed by Kyle (drone-sizer): backend owns the 5090 truth-source + precision lane. Harness: qualcomm scratchpad/driving_vla_proxy{2,3}.py + quant_lowbit.py.
__meta__.metric: next-token KL vs fp16 (backbone weights+acts). Lower = closer to fp16. Schemes: INT8 sym/asym, INT4, FP8-E4M3/E5M2, MXFP4 (block-32 E8M0), Mixed (int8 body + fp16 top-2).

driving_vla_kl_vs_fp16.note: backbone KL; its flow-matching diffusion action head is separately fp16-only (head-type taxonomy)

two_regimes.outlier_heavy: 4 driving (OpenEMMA 13x, AutoVLA 7x, Alpamayo 16x, DriveVLM 4x) + 4 cross-family LLMs: INT4 SHATTERS (KL 0.18-17), MXFP4 RESCUES 7-328x (per-block E8M0 scales preserve the activation outliers a uniform int4 grid clips). The general case for large LLM backbones.
two_regimes.benign: OpenDriveVLA-0.5B, OpenVLA-7b: INT4 already fine (KL<=0.02); MXFP4 does NOT help and can HURT (OpenVLA 2.0 — coarse 8-level e2m1 loses to uniform int4's 16 levels absent outliers). Matches the BitVLA regression-head result (head_type_dimension in the companion anchor).
two_regimes.per_scheme: INT8-sym ~= lossless everywhere. FP8-E4M3 ~= lossless (exponent handles outliers) > E5M2. Mixed (int8 body + fp16 head) ~= lossless. MXFP4 is a RESCUE for outlier-heavy sub-8-bit, NOT a free win.

consistency_with_thesis: Reinforces the microscaling refinement (precision_accuracy_validation_qualcomm.json): microscaling is the non-negotiable below 8-bit for OUTLIER-HEAVY tensors, and its value is model-dependent (hurts benign/narrow tensors). Driving VLAs split the same two ways as manipulation VLAs + LLM families.
iq9075_deploy_read: v73 natively runs INT8 + FP16 (+ INT4 weight-storage). INT8/mixed lossless -> safe deploy floor for all 6. Outlier-heavy backbones needing sub-8-bit want MXFP4 -> exactly the mxfp4-on-v73 capability (hw-ready, producer-gated per qualcomm's silicon work).
